name: ranger_slide_wall
description: Ranger swing-slide on wall. Matches WB diagram S4 (L=640). Ranger at (460,500) grapples to ceiling, swings right into wall at x=1400, Circle to slide UP, release to boost LEFT.
script: # --- Exact WB geometry: S4 at (460, 500), hook at (960,100), L=640 ---
# This rope reaches the wall at x=1400 (wall_y=564.8)
# Grapple aimed at ceiling — direction from (460,500) toward (960,100)
# Swing RIGHT hard — need enough momentum to reach the wall
announce Swinging right — building momentum toward wall
# At the right side of the swing, ranger approaches the wall.
# The velocity is upward+right (WB yellow vector at wall).
# Circle to slide UP the wall.
announce Approaching wall — Circle to SLIDE UP
# Sliding UP the wall. Gravity has 100% effect (vertical surface).
# The slide decelerates as gravity pulls down.
announce SLIDING UP wall — gravity=100% on vertical — charge building
# Release Circle — boost launch LEFT off wall
announce Release Circle — BOOST LAUNCH LEFT off wall
notify {SCRIPT} "Did ranger slide UP wall and boost-launch LEFT?" ["YES","NO","PARTIAL"] {inspect} blocking
